before: Tab over a selected paragraph replaced the selection with a tab character, which deleted the selected text.
after: Tab over a selection of whole paragraphs writes w:ind with the existing setParagraphProperties operation and keeps the text. A caret or a selection that starts inside the text still types a tab.
reason: The change uses only the existing paragraph property operation that Increase Indent already sends. It adds no shared state, operations, snapshot fields, or protocol messages.
